title: Scanner emits evidence for every grounded property

comments.author: os
comments.text:
As a DataParade user, I want each scanner-derived property to include source evidence, so that I can verify why the value was inferred.

Feature: Per-property scanner evidence
  Scenario: Grounded properties retain citations
    Given a scanner finding with a source location
    When rules and heuristics produce component properties
    Then each non-empty user property includes one or more evidence rows
    And grouping and postprocessing preserve the union of evidence rows

  Scenario: Ungrounded heuristics stay empty
    Given a component without source locations or detected-from locations
    When scanner heuristics run
    Then they do not set a property value that requires evidence
